content.title: Pi Day 2026 deals on March 14
content.text: Every year on March 14 (3/14), Pi Day is celebrated by many restaurants and grocery stores with deals on dessert pies and pizza pies! Read on for the list of tasty offers for 2026. Posted 3/10/2026, 4:15:19 AM Updated 3/14/2026, 4:34:18 PM Pizza in box * This post contains affiliate links and we earn a commission on qualifying purchases. Every year on March 14 (3/14), Pi Day is celebrated by many restaurants with deals on dessert pies and pizza pies! Read on for the list of offers for Saturday, March 14, 2026. Keep in mind that these deals are only available at participating locations. In case you are wondering, Pi, or π, is the ratio of the circumference of a circle to its diameter. It is often shortened to 3.14 which is why 3/14 (March 14) is the official day to celebrate all things Pi...or Pie. And here's an interesting fact: Mathematical genius Albert Einstein was born on March 14, 1879. BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse On March 14, 2026, get a Regular Pizookie for $3.14 when you buy any Sharable or Large Pizza on their website or app and enter the promo code PIDAY at checkout. See the details on their website. Blaze Pizza On March 14, 2026, buy one Blaze Pizza 11” pizza & get another for $3.14 in-store only at participating locations. See the offer posted on their Facebook page. Burger King On March 14, 2026, get a free Burger King Hershey’s Sundae Pie or Cinnamon Apple Pie with a purchase of $3.14 or more in their app or on their website. They are offering a free item with purchase each day this week (March 8-14) for reward members during their Perks Week promotion. See the details on their app or website. Domino's Domino's is offering their "best deal ever", according to their website. Get any pizza with any toppings for $9.99. Limit 7 toppings. They are also offering any 2 participating items for $6.99 each including select pizzas. See the details on their website. Marco’s Pizza Marco’s Pizza is offering a medium 1-topping pizza for $3.14 with the purchase of any large or extra-large menu-priced pizza when you use the code PIDAY at online or app checkout on March 14, 2026. The offer is available only at participating locations. MOD Pizza MOD Pizza Rewards members get $3.14 off the purchase of a MOD-size pizza on March 14, 2026 when you order in the app and use the coupon code IRRATIONAL at checkout. In addition, 314 people will get their order for $3.14. MOD Pizza is also offering a free Pi Day poster available for download. See the details for all of these offers on their website. Papa Johns Papa Johns has a number of specials available including Papa Pairings (get participating items for $6.99 each when you buy 2 or more including select pizzas), a large 1-topping carryout pizza for $7.99 and more. See their website for deals at your specific store. Papa Murphy's Pizza Get 31.4% off your Papa Murphy's order on March 14, 2026 when you use the code PIDAY26 online. See the offer posted on their Facebook page. Pizza Hut Pizza Hut has multiple offers including the $7 Deal Lovers when you buy 2 or more participating items, carryout pizza starting at $10, the Big Dinner Box starting at $24.99 & more at participating locations. See the deals for your local store on their website. Sheetz "Sheetz will celebrate National Pi Day (3/14) by offering customers specially priced $3.14 cheese or pepperoni pizza flatz. This special offer is available from National Pi Day (Saturday, March 14) through Friday, March 20, 2026. This promotion can only be redeemed through the Sheetz app. Customers must add the offer under the OFFERZ tab in the Sheetz app to redeem it at any of Sheetz’s 810+ locations," according to the Sheetz PR folks. Speedway and 7-Eleven On March 13 and March 14, 2026, participating Speedway and 7-Eleven stores are offering reward members a whole pizza for $3.14 in stores and through their 7NOW® Delivery app. They are also offering 31.4 cent Cinnamon Sugar Fried Pies, $1 7-Select™ Snack Pies and $3.14 Quesadillas. See their press release for details. The Durham On Saturday, March 14, 2026 starting at 2 pm, the Coffee Bar at The Durham is offering slices of pies available for $3.14 from Durham baker, Phoebe Lawless. Choices include Chocolate Chess, Lemon Chess and Buttermilk Sugar. Located at 315 East Chapel Hill Street, Durham, NC. Groupon Multiple Raleigh and Triangle area pizza restaurants have discount offers through Groupon including Brixx in Raleigh, Vic's Pizzeria in Raleigh, Chuck E. Cheese in Raleigh, Nancy's Pizzeria in Raleigh, Rudino's in Knightdale, Divano's Pizzeria in Garner, Johnny's Pizza (multiple locations) and more! These offers were available as of March 8, 2026. Be sure to put in your zip code or town to see the deals in your specific town HERE. DoorDash According to the DoorDash press release, "Customers nationwide can take advantage of the following Pi Day offers in the DoorDash app: Pizza Hut: Buy one medium or large ‘Create Your Own’ pizza, get one free from participating locations on March 14, 2026.Sbarro: Enjoy $4 off eligible orders of $20 or more from all participating Sbarro locations on DoorDash from March 14, 2026 through April 6, 2026.Blaze Pizza: Buy one ‘Simple Pie’ 11-inch cheese pizza, get one free from participating locations from March 14, 2026 through April 6, 2026." See offers on the DoorDash app for details and restrictions. Grocery Deals These deals are valid at participating Raleigh area locations. Check the ads for your specific store to verify prices because sales can vary between locations. Food Lion: Snack pies in the bakery, 3.25-4 oz, $1 each. Valid March 11-17 Food Lion: Red Baron 12" Pizzas, select, frozen, 15.77-23.45 oz, $4.49 - $1.50 Food Lion digital coupon = $2.99. Limit 1. Valid March 11-17. Harris Teeter: Flatbread Pizzas for $3.14 on Pi Day. Valid March 14, 2026 Harris Teeter: Fresh Foods Market 9" Gourmet Apple Pie for $5.85 or Key Lime Pie for $6.85. Valid March 11-17 Harris Teeter: All Hot and Take & Bake Pizzas for $7.99 through March 17 Lidl: Red Baron Pizza, select, frozen, 17.89-21.06. $3.49. Valid March 11-17 Lowes Foods: Apple Pie in the Bakery, 8 inch, $5.99. Valid March 11-17 Publix: Small apple pie in the bakery, 12 oz, $3.14 .
